title: Set feed-line clamp spacing from the installed vibration spectrum
summary: Clamp spacing on a fuel feed pipe set from static loads led to a fatigue indication on first ground running.
what_happened: Feed pipe rev A cracked adjacent to a P-clamp after ground running of effectivity 1 (ISS-D-0000058).
root_cause: The installed vibration spectrum was not available at the B and C reviews; ACT-D-0000102 was closed, and accepted, on static-load evidence.
recommendation: Do not accept closure of spacing actions without the installed spectrum or an agreed conservative envelope; make checklist item SA-B-V01 require spectrum evidence.
applicability: Rigid pipework supported by clamps in vibration zones.
